title: Phase 5 End-to-End System Validation and Scientific Evidence Report

uncalibrated_probability_protection.disclaimer_text: A calibrated probability of mineral occurrence has not been established. Model values represent relative spatial indices only.

underground_coal_seams.policy: DO NOT infer underground coal seams from satellite spectral indices alone. Subsurface seams require drill-core logs and seismic surveys.

iron_ore_surface_staining.policy: Surface ferric iron index (B04/B02) reflects weathering/gossans and lateritic crusts, not confirmed commercial hematite or magnetite ore.

bauxite_duricrust_distinction.policy: Satellite SWIR clay ratios detect aluminous laterite and kaolinitic clays, but cannot distinguish commercial gibbsitic bauxite without XRD/XRF laboratory assays.

geographic_footprint_confinement.manganese_model: Random Forest v1 (T44QMK Balaghat Sausar belt)
geographic_footprint_confinement.outside_footprint_behavior: Returns model_coverage='OUTSIDE_TRAINING_FOOTPRINT' and prediction=None. Never extrapolates to other tiles.
geographic_footprint_confinement.unsupported_commodities_behavior: Coal, Iron Ore, Bauxite return model_coverage='NO_MODEL_FOR_COMMODITY' and overall_status='EVIDENCE_ONLY_NO_PREDICTION'.

fallback_mechanism.quick_action: Provides one-click 2D Satellite View toggle button

frontend_integration.vite_development_proxy: Configured in frontend/vite.config.js forwarding /api, /analyze, /classify-image to backend:8001
frontend_integration.cors_configuration: FastAPI CORSMiddleware enabled for localhost:5173, 5174, 3000, and 127.0.0.1
frontend_integration.stale_result_lifecycle: React useEffect triggers result reset on location, mineral, or radius change in App.jsx
frontend_integration.multi_mineral_scorecards: Four independent commodity cards with distinct evidence inventories, avoiding state cross-contamination

defects_list.title: Manganese ML model restricted to Sentinel-2 Tile T44QMK
defects_list.description: The Random Forest model is trained strictly on the Balaghat-Nagpur-Bhandara manganese belt. Locations outside this tile return OUTSIDE_TRAINING_FOOTPRINT.
defects_list.workaround_or_status: By design. Prevents dangerous spatial overfitting and maintains strict scientific integrity.
defects_list.remediation_path: Train regional models for Odisha (Keonjhar/Bonai), Karnataka (Sandur), and Andhra Pradesh with dedicated field truth.

defects_list.title: Coal, Iron Ore, and Bauxite operate in evidence-only baseline mode
defects_list.description: No machine learning prospectivity models are deployed for Coal, Iron Ore, or Bauxite; the system provides multi-spectral index evidence and geological rules only.
defects_list.workaround_or_status: Truthful representation. The API explicitly reports model_coverage='NO_MODEL_FOR_COMMODITY'.
defects_list.remediation_path: Curate verified deposit point databases and regional lithology shapefiles for commercial iron ore, bauxite, and coal basins.

defects_list.title: Production CNN rejects real-world field photographs due to synthetic domain shift
defects_list.description: Trained on synthetic texture tiles; field photographs containing hands, scales, background paper, or outdoor lighting exceed the tau=5.0 OOD threshold.
defects_list.workaround_or_status: Strict OOD gatekeeper protects production safety. Candidate fine-tuned model and specimen isolation pipelines remain isolated in experimental registry.
defects_list.remediation_path: Collect and certify macroscopic rock specimens under standardized studio and field lighting with accredited laboratory assays.

defects_list.title: Copernicus CDSE live token acquisition requires valid subscriber credentials in .env
defects_list.description: Without valid CDSE credentials, requests log HTTP 403 / network lookup errors and fall back gracefully to local test mode or mock mode.
defects_list.workaround_or_status: System reports cdse_auth_status truthfully and does not fabricate fake satellite products.
defects_list.remediation_path: Deploy production CDSE OAuth2 client credentials in deployment environment.

software_system_readiness.justification: All 335 Python unit/integration tests pass (1 skipped), 265 JavaScript tests pass across 25 files, frontend production build completes with 0 errors in 4.57s, 19/19 live API endpoint contracts verified, CORS and proxies fully operational, and safe fallbacks prevent application crashes.

scientific_field_readiness.justification: While software safeguards are immaculate, the system cannot be deployed for commercial mineral exploration decision-making without: (1) Certified laboratory assays for specimen training photos, (2) Multi-basin spatial validation for manganese, and (3) Dedicated geological ML models for Coal, Iron Ore, and Bauxite.
